narr: Deep tropical monsoon moisture interacted with an approaching upper level low moving towards the southern California coastline to bring strong thunderstorms and flash flooding to the region.
ev: A county official reported a 5 foot rise in 45 minutes at the Rio de Flag Coconino County ALERT gauge located near the Flagstaff Mall.
A USGS stream gauge on the Little Colorado River near Woodruff reported a 6.3 foot rise in one hour from near nearby thunderstorms producing heavy rainfall.
A USGS river gauge on the Agua Fria River at Cordes Lakes reported at 5.9 foot rise in 45 minutes from thunderstorms upstream along Big Bug Creek.
A Yavapai County river gauge on the Agua Fria River at Kelton Ranch reported a 6.3 foot rise in 15 minutes. Peak flow was 9,515 cubic feet per second.
Yavapai County Sheriff's Office reported a bridge in Spring Valley was impassable with water flowing over the road. A car was also stranded on the bridge.
Public sent via social media a video of a flash flood along Big Bug Creek. The person posting the video said it was the highest flow since 2021.
Public reported, via social media, a video of flash flooding in Big Bug Creek across a low water crossing.
